html:
Slovakia is a landlocked country in Central Europe that became independent on 1 January 1993, when Czechoslovakia split peacefully in two. Its capital is Bratislava.

Slavs settled the land around the 6th century, and it was part of Great Moravia in the 9th. For about a thousand years after that it belonged to the Kingdom of Hungary; Bratislava, then called Pressburg, was even the Hungarian coronation city for a time. In 1918 Slovaks joined Czechs in the new state of Czechoslovakia, and in 1939 to 1945 a separate Slovak state existed under Nazi protection.

After communism fell in 1989, the two nations could not agree on how to share power, and their leaders negotiated the dissolution of Czechoslovakia without a referendum. Slovakia joined NATO and the European Union in 2004 and adopted the euro in 2009. Its car factories make it one of the world's biggest car producers per person.
sum: Slovakia is a landlocked country in Central Europe that became independent on 1 January 1993, when Czechoslovakia split peacefully in two. Its capital is Bratislava.
